kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: F-19 (heuristic) [Minor] (memo §3 L98): At one-tick rows a 7.5 h BTCUSDT range is 2 251 rows, under 0.3 px each in a 640 px pane; rows merge (×8 to ×15) and per-row text is impossible, so only named levels can carry words (§4.3)

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: F-14 (heuristic) [Minor] (memo §3 L93): Levels are sparse: a missing row means no trade, a row with delta 0 means balance; in the trade fixture 40 of 55 rows in the span are untraded (§4.2), so the two cases are common and must look different
